context: Teacher gives a reflective lecture on how to study effectively
purpose: Teach: とくに/きわめて/あくまで/どんなに/仮に/たいへん/だんだん/なぜなら

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 今日は勉強の仕方について、たいへん大事なお話をします。とくに集中力の作り方ですね。
lines.en: Today I'll share a truly important talk about how to study, especially how to build focus.
lines.style: Warm teacherly opening, measured pace, gentle authority in voice

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、どんなに頑張っても集中が続かないんです。なぜなら、すぐスマホを見ちゃって…。
lines.en: Teacher, no matter how hard I try, my focus doesn't last. Because I keep checking my phone...
lines.style: Sheepish university student confession, slightly self-deprecating tone

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: わかりますよ。仮に一日五時間勉強するなら、休憩の取り方がきわめて重要になります。
lines.en: I understand. If, say, you study five hours a day, then how you take breaks becomes extremely important.
lines.style: Thoughtful pedagogical explanation, calm reassuring cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 五時間ですか…。あくまで理想ですけど、最初は三十分も持ちません。
lines.en: Five hours, huh... That's purely an ideal, but at first I can't even last thirty minutes.
lines.style: Honest admission, half-laughing nervously at his own limits

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 最初はそれでいいんです。だんだん体が慣れてきますから、焦らないでくださいね。
lines.en: That's fine at first. Your body gradually gets used to it, so please don't rush.
lines.style: Encouraging maternal warmth, slow deliberate phrasing for comfort

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: だんだん、ですか。なんだか少し気が楽になりました。
lines.en: Gradually, you say. Somehow that takes a bit of weight off my shoulders.
lines.style: Quiet relief surfacing, softer reflective tone of voice

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 勉強はあくまで自分のためのものですから、人と比べないこと。これが一番の秘訣ですよ。
lines.en: Studying is, after all, purely for yourself, so don't compare with others. That's the biggest secret.
lines.style: Sincere closing wisdom, leaning forward with quiet conviction

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、心に刻みます。今日のお話、たいへん勉強になりました。ありがとうございました。
lines.en: Yes, I'll engrave it in my heart. Today's talk was truly educational. Thank you very much.
lines.style: Formal grateful bow in voice, sincere student humility
